post.description: Use when the user wants a team's or league's gear or a department within it. league_id comes from a search facet (type o), team_id from list_teams, department_id from a facet option of type d. Pass url instead of ids to follow a facet or breadcrumb path returned by this function or search_products.

department_id.description:
Fanatics department id (the d- segment), e.g. 8019 = Sweatshirts; from a facet option of type d.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

include_facets.description: Include the site's facet groups (leagues, departments, players, brands, price bands) with their option URLs. Set false for a smaller result when only the products matter.

league_id.description:
Fanatics league/org id (the o- segment), e.g. 23 = NBA, 25 = NFL, 19 = MLB, 5 = College.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

page.description:
1-based page number (the site's pageNumber).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 1.

page_size.description:
Products per page (the site's pageSize). The storefront UI offers 24, 48, 72 and 96.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 96; default 24.

sort.description:
Sort order (the site's sortOption values).

Provider reference: allowed values ["TopSellers", "NewestArrivals", "LowestPrice", "HighestPrice"]; default "TopSellers".

team_id.description:
Fanatics team id (the t- segment), e.g. 3356 = Atlanta Hawks; from list_teams.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

url.description: A www.fanatics.com listing URL or path (from a facet option, breadcrumb or the address bar). Mutually exclusive with the id inputs.
